notes: Nearby rain gauge; rainfall is not measured on the campus.
Daily qualified totals retain original quality and completeness, including rejected readings.
EA daily dates have a 09:00 boundary in the raw dateTime; they are daily observations, not midnight hourly storms.
2018, 2020 and 2025 each contain every day with Good quality and Complete status. Other years are inspection-only.
